_about: Facts each case plants in the synthetic data, written with cases.json and before the data. scripts/generate_data.py plants them and scripts/check_data.py verifies them. Checks: usage (trend healthy or declining), transcript (speaker says this exact sentence), opp (type, status, owner, reason), contact (account, name, last_updated window), meddpicc (champion and its last_updated date), lead_note (the lead's form note contains this text).
